name: UpdateDeviceShadow

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If this ID value exists, you must specify it. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Overview page or ID value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html

parameters.help_en:
The modified device shadow information.
The shadow information contains the following parameters:
method: String. The operation type. Set the value to update.

state: String. The specific state sent to the device shadow. The desired parameter specifies the desired property value of the device shadow.

version: Long. The version of the device shadow.
    - If version control is not required, set this value to 0.
    - If version control is required, this value must be greater than the current shadow version.


<notice>When version control is required, do not directly query the current shadow version from IoT Platform. This is because when update and query operations have high concurrency, multiple update operations may query the same shadow version. In this case, the last initiated update operation may complete first, which causes the final updated shadow information to not be the latest. We recommend that you maintain the shadow version locally and obtain the latest shadow version from your local application when calling this operation.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
修改后的设备影子信息。
影子信息参数中包含：
method：String，指定操作类型，取值：update。

state：String，发送给影子的具体状态，由desired参数表示期望的影子状态。

version：Long，设备影子的版本。
    - 若无需版本控制，该值设置为0。
    - 若需要版本控制，该值必须大于当前影子版本。


<notice>需要版本控制时，不能直接从物联网平台查询当前影子版本。因为更新和查询操作并发量高时，可能导致多个更新操作查询到同一个影子版本。基于此情况，最后一次发起的更新操作可能先完成，进而导致最终更新的影子信息不是最新的影子信息。所以，建议您本地维护影子版本，调用本接口时，从本地应用获取最新影子版本。
</notice>
